text:
sara_support: urgent — Cardea Labs trial blocked during onboarding. Customers hitting 403 on embeddings ingest and SSO provisioning stuck. Cardea needs go/no-go for GA in 3 days. Ticket#78941. Need CS handoff and comms plan. :rotating_light:
incbot: Support ticket #78941 created by sara_support. Priority: high. Linked to case 5543.
sara_support: adding minimal repro and response — curl below and the 403 body.
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' 
  -d '{"input":"test"}'
```
Response: {"error":"403","msg":"billing:quota"}
emma_cs: on it. Can you drop last successful ingestion timestamp and the account id?
sara_support: last success 5312345400. tenant_id: cardea-001. Forwarded SAML trace and support debug token to #support.
maya_ops: looking at infra logs — saw an authentication routing mismatch at 03:12 UTC that routed Cardea traffic to a shared quota pool. Tagging infra. @jamal_cs can you own customer comms and alignment?
jamal_cs: I can own. First step: confirm whether this is quota enforcement or an auth routing bug. sara, please forward the debug token and SAML trace to me. Also propose a 30min enablement call today at 16:00 PST — does Cardea confirm?
sara_support: forwarded SAML trace and token tx_Ab12 to this thread and ticket. Cardea confirmed 4pm PST works. Meeting placeholder created. :thumbsup:
emma_cs: drafting comms plan (short):
1) Acknowledge within 1h with clear ETA.
2) Technical triage now — share logs & timeline.
3) Enablement call (today 16:00 PST) to walk through SSO and ingest flow.
4) Temporary mitigation: reroute embeddings to lightweight model m2 and enable prefix caching to avoid re-upload.
5) Post-call follow-up + renewal manager sync if risk remains.
jamal_cs: approved. I'll send acknowledgement and own the call. Sara — can support run the fallback test with a single sample to confirm no data re-upload?
sara_support: Cardea agreed to fallback. They want to avoid full re-upload; prefer prefix caching. I can run a single ingestion test once ops flips the route.
maya_ops: we can enable prefix cache on their tenant and reroute to m2. One-off CLI to apply: 
```
redwood-cli tenant patch cardea-001 --cache-prefix=enabled --route-model=m2
```
I'll hold and coordinate the change after we confirm communication.
jamal_cs: plan and owners: 
- Acknowledge & initial comms: jamal_cs (within 1h)
- Gather logs & triage: sara_support, emma_cs (now)
- Fallback config & run: maya_ops (apply patch)
- Enablement call: jamal_cs host 16:00 PST
- Renewal flag + follow-up: emma_cs
Expected ETA for unblocking: ~2 hours post-patch if fallback succeeds.
incbot: Ticket #78941 updated: 'fallback route pending' — awaiting ops change.
maya_ops: applying patch now. Will post outcome.
incbot: Ticket #78941 updated: 'fallback route enabled' by maya_ops at 5312345805.
maya_ops: patch applied. Monitoring ingestion; metrics show 0 -> 120 req/min. No 403s observed since 5312345810. :rocket:
jamal_cs: great. I'll run the 4pm call and capture enablement notes. Quick handoff summary for CS: issue type: onboarding ingestion auth/quota routing; actions taken: temporary route to m2 + prefix cache enabled; next steps: verify full onboarding flow, confirm SSO stability, update renewal team if needed. Renewal risk: medium, mitigated if no regressions in 48h.
emma_cs: I'll add this to the CS playbook and mark as "needs follow-up" in 48h. Thanks team. :clap:
